legal_hero_title: Legal Notes, Compliance and Disclaimer of AtmBet
legal_hero_desc: Transparency is the pillar of our quantitative approach. In this section we explain in detail the nature of our services, compliance with current regulations, infrastructure security, and user protection guarantees.
legal_card1_text: AtmBet is a digital platform and statistical monitoring software (Tipster Tracker) designed for quantitative analysis, tracking historical sports data, and processing performance metrics (Yield, ROI, Win Rate).
legal_card1_box: Operational clarification: We are not a bookmaker, we do not manage gaming accounts, we do not collect bets, and we do not handle third-party money or capital.
legal_card2_text: Account, plan, and access code management is handled through a secure synchronization system encrypted via direct APIs with secure authentication protocols.
legal_card2_box: Privacy: We strictly comply with EU Regulation (GDPR) principles regarding personal data protection. No sensitive data is shared with third parties.
legal_card3_text: Information and statistical selections shared through our dedicated Telegram channels are solely for informational, educational, and statistical reporting purposes.
legal_card3_box: Autonomy: Users maintain total and absolute control over their personal choices and any autonomous activities outside the platform.
legal_card4_text: Past statistical data, success rates (Win Rate), and historical profits recorded by various providers within the console represent simulations based on past objective data and do not constitute any mathematical guarantee of future profit.
legal_card4_box: Responsibility: Sports analysis activity involves statistical risks. An approach based on rigorous personal budget management is strongly recommended.
legal_card5_text: All contents, logos, source code, graphic interfaces, and statistical analysis models present on AtmBet are the exclusive property of the platform or licensed. Unauthorized reproduction or resale of subscription-protected signals is prohibited.
legal_card5_box: Protection: Any violations or misuse of access codes and protected Telegram flows will result in immediate subscription revocation without refund.
legal_card6_text: Match results and outcome verifications are processed entirely through automated integrations with third-party sports data providers (including API-Football). AtmBet disclaims any liability for errors or update delays attributable to external APIs.
legal_card6_box: Updates: The system performs continuous checks to ensure maximum consistency and transparency of historical outcomes.
